test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.**

By the time / we will reach the station, / the train will have already left.

options.text: the train will have already left

solution:
Here, the erroneous part is** "we will reach the station."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence **"By the time we will reach the station, the train will have already left" **contains a grammatical error.
 
• In English, we do not use** "will" **after phrases like** "by the time," "when," "after," etc.**
 
• These phrases already indicate future time, so there's no need to use** "will"** again in the same clause.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

**Correct sent ence**: *By the time **we reach the station**__, the train will have already left.*
